summary: Full backend + frontend testing of StudyAce complete. 20/20 pytest backend tests pass covering auth, courses, documents, folders, quiz generation (mcq/flashcards/fill_blank), attempt scoring, quiz rename+move+delete, folder delete unassignment, chat, study plan, and dashboard. Frontend E2E via Playwright covered register->create course->upload+preview->create subfolder->generate MCQ into subfolder (slider max verified =50)->folder-chip filter->play MCQ with immediate feedback (option-0/feedback testid)->finish score->rename+move->delete->flashcards reveal + right/wrong self-marking with resulting score (67% observed on alternating right/wrong)->fill_blank type answer + immediate feedback with correct answer + explanation + source->AI chat reply->AI study plan day-by-day->dashboard counts/weak areas reflected. All flows PASSED.

issues: 'Generate with AI' button drifts to the far right on wide screens leaving large empty space next to the 'Practice Quizzes & Flashcards' heading (see screenshot). Cosmetic only.
Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby - accessibility warning in console. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent components to remove a11y console warnings.
(Optional cosmetic) Wrap Quizzes tab header + Generate button in a flex container so the button sits next to the title on wide screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_course cascades delete_many for quizzes/folders but only soft-deletes documents (is_deleted=true) - acceptable but inconsistent; ensure download endpoint continues to check is_deleted (it does).

server.py normalize() answer matching for text quizzes uses substring containment when gold>3 chars: this may create false positives when a very common short user answer is a substring of the gold (e.g. 'test' vs 'testing'). Consider stricter matching (word boundaries) or LLM-graded correctness.
QuizGenInput.num_questions has no Pydantic bound; frontend enforces 3-50 via slider but backend accepts any int (could be abused to send 500 questions which would hammer LLM and time out).
No pagination on list endpoints (courses, documents, quizzes) - .to_list(1000) hard cap could silently truncate power users.
generate_quiz LLM prompt truncates material to 120k chars but does not chunk/multi-doc summarize; large PDFs may lose content beyond the first document.
delete_quiz / delete_course / delete_folder return {'ok': true} even when nothing matched (no 404) - clients cannot distinguish missing resources.
CORS middleware uses os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL', 'http://localhost:3000') list - CORS_ORIGINS env var declared in .env ('*') is unused.
chat_with_docs stores messages after LLM response; on LLM failure user message is lost from history.
storage_key global is not thread-safe under concurrent uploads (races on force refresh) - unlikely to bite but worth a lock.

Frontend delete_quiz has no confirmation dialog wired up (relies on browser confirm via page.on('dialog')). Actually - reviewing code: there is NO window.confirm call; the current UI deletes on single click with no confirmation which is a UX/data-loss risk.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@studyace.app / admin123 (verified). Ephemeral UI test users created via /auth/register with example.com emails.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a fresh test_<uuid>@example.com user, a course, a document, a subfolder, MCQ + flashcards + fill_blank quizzes, a study plan; folder gets deleted at the end and flashcards quiz gets deleted. Other TEST_ prefixed data (course, remaining quiz, plan) persists per that test user. Frontend test creates a separate ui_<uuid>@example.com user and its own artifacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; if you need serial execution use `-n 0` (not `-p no:xdist`). All required env comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. LLM (Gemini 3 Flash via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) generation takes 5-20s; extend timeouts accordingly (used 60-120s in tests). The quiz card testid is `quiz-<uuid>` but the generate-dialog quiz-type buttons are `quiz-type-mcq` etc., so filter by UUID shape (36 chars, 4 hyphens) when scraping.
rca of the issue: N/A - all tested features work as specified.
